films.title: Adieu Philippine
films.cast: Jean-Claude Aimini, Stefania Sabatini, Yveline Cery
films.syn: Paris, 1960: a young TV stagehand waiting to be sent to the war in Algeria spends his last weeks of freedom with two inseparable girlfriends. Jacques Rozier.

films.title: Virgin suicides
films.cast: Kirsten Dunst, James Woods, Kathleen Turner
films.syn: 1970s suburbia: the five secretive Lisbon sisters fascinate the neighbourhood boys, who try for years to understand what happened to them. Sofia Coppola.

films.title: Metropolis
films.cast: Yuka Imoto, Kei Kobayashi, Kohki Okada
films.syn: In a futuristic city where humans and robots live side by side, a detective and his nephew search for a scientist and find a mysterious girl. Anime from Osamu Tezuka's manga.

films.title: Boule de feu
films.cast: Oscar Homolka, Henry Travers, S.Z. Sakall
films.syn: A nightclub singer hiding from the police hides out with eight professors writing an encyclopedia, and turns the shy linguist's head. Howard Hawks.

films.title: Punishment Park
films.cast: Patrick Boland, Kent Foreman, Carmen Argenziano
films.syn: A political fable set in 1970: arrested protesters can choose prison or a deadly race across the desert, filmed as a fake documentary. Peter Watkins.

films.title: Les Sentiers de la gloire
films.cast: Kirk Douglas, Ralph Meeker, Adolphe Menjou
films.syn: 1916: after a suicidal attack fails, a French general orders three soldiers tried for cowardice, and their colonel tries to defend them. Stanley Kubrick.

films.title: Les Petites Marguerites
films.cast: Ivana Karbanova, Jitka Cerhova, Marie Cesková
films.syn: Two bored young women, both called Marie, decide the world is spoilt and set out to be spoilt too, in a playful burst of anarchy. Věra Chytilová.

films.title: Témoin à charge
films.cast: Tyrone Power, Marlene Dietrich, Charles Laughton
films.syn: A great barrister recovering from a heart attack defends a man accused of murder, in a case full of twists. Billy Wilder, from Agatha Christie.

films.title: Cinema Paradiso
films.cast: Philippe Noiret, Jacques Perrin, Salvatore Cascio
films.syn: When the old projectionist Alfredo dies, a successful film director goes back to his Sicilian village and remembers the cinema where he grew up. Giuseppe Tornatore.

films.title: Le Septième Sceau
films.cast: Max von Sydow, Gunnar Björnstrand, Bengt Ekerot
films.syn: Back from the Crusades, a knight challenges Death to a game of chess to buy time and find answers about faith. Ingmar Bergman.

films.title: Quand la mer monte
films.cast: Yolande Moreau, Wim Willaert, Olivier Gourmet
films.syn: On tour in northern France with her one-woman show, a comedian meets a man who carries carnival giants, and falls in love. Yolande Moreau.

films.title: Los Muertos
films.cast: Argentino Vargas, Francisco Dornez, Yolanda Galarza
films.syn: Released from prison, a 54-year-old man travels by boat through the Argentine marshes to find his grown-up daughter. Lisandro Alonso.

films.title: Thelma et Louise
films.cast: Geena Davis, Susan Sarandon, Harvey Keitel
films.syn: Two friends set off on a weekend road trip that turns into a flight from the law across the American Southwest. Ridley Scott, with Susan Sarandon and Geena Davis.

films.title: Docteur Folamour
films.cast: Peter Sellers, George C. Scott, Sterling Hayden
films.syn: A paranoid US general launches a nuclear attack on the USSR, and the president and his advisers scramble to stop it. Stanley Kubrick's black comedy.

films.title: Monsieur Klein
films.cast: Alain Delon, Jeanne Moreau, Michael Lonsdale
films.syn: Paris under the Occupation: an art dealer profiting from Jewish families' sales is mistaken for a Jewish namesake and tries to find the other man. Joseph Losey.

films.title: Vivre sa vie: Film en douze tableaux
films.cast: Anna Karina, Sady Rebbot, Andre S. Labarthe
films.syn: In twelve scenes, a young Parisian woman leaves her husband to become an actress and drifts into prostitution. Jean-Luc Godard, with Anna Karina.

films.title: Trois couleurs - Bleu
films.cast: Juliette Binoche, Hélène Vincent, Philippe Volter
films.syn: After losing her husband, a famous composer, and their daughter in a crash, a woman tries to cut herself off from everything. Krzysztof Kieślowski, with Juliette Binoche.

films.title: Passion d'amour
films.cast: Bernard Giraudeau, Valeria d'Obici, Laura Antonelli
films.syn: 1862: a cavalry captain posted to a provincial garrison is pursued by his colonel's sickly, obsessive cousin. Ettore Scola.

films.title: Shining
films.cast: Jack Nicholson, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Shelley Duvall
films.syn: A writer takes a winter caretaker job at an isolated Colorado hotel with his wife and son, and the place slowly drives him mad. Stanley Kubrick.

films.title: Rivière sans retour
films.cast: Robert Mitchum, Marilyn Monroe, Rory Calhoun
films.syn: 1875: a former convict, his young son and a saloon singer drift down a dangerous river by raft, chased by outlaws and hostile country. With Marilyn Monroe and Robert Mitchum.

films.title: Sueurs froides
films.cast: James Stewart, Kim Novak, Barbara Bel Geddes
films.syn: A detective with a fear of heights is hired to follow an old friend's wife, and becomes obsessed with her. Alfred Hitchcock.

films.title: Evil Dead 2
films.cast: Bruce Campbell, Sarah Berry, Dan Hicks
films.syn: A young couple stays in a remote cabin where a professor unleashed demons from the Book of the Dead, and the night turns into gory slapstick. Sam Raimi.
